title: JK 2018
text: Congratulations to our 29 SuffOC members who competed at the 2018 JK event over the Easter weekend. The sprint event was held at MOD Stafford and the others on Cannock Chase. Weather conditions varied from 'Fine' to 'Wet, cold, muddy, misty, with a sprinkling of overnight snow'. The results summary can be seen here and selected photos on our Facebook page. Links to the overall results and photos can be found on the JK 2018 website.
